question: Under which amendment in The Constitutional Act 1992 did the Panchayati Raj Institutions receive their constitutional status?
solution:
The correct answer is __**73rd Amendment**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **73rd Amendment:**

 
 
• The 73rd Amendment to the Constitution of India, enacted in 1992, granted constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).
 
• This amendment is a landmark in the history of local self-governance in India.
